limits: Selective archive of received M7 artifacts, not a grade or runnable clone. All observer events are inventoried, but only safe evidence under m7 or observed after phase start is copied, excluding generated residency, provider logs and objects over 1 MB. Earlier inherited scale receipts remain outside this M7 copy. Intermediate original source manifests remain external; a derived change history and the first/last original manifests are local. Script bodies remain hash-only; selected application sources use explicit conservative literal redactions with separate original/archive hashes. The two-second observer can miss writes. Raw model streams, stores, credentials and most generated artifacts are omitted.
